# `auth_session`

Signed-in session for one user in one tenant (IAM-04, IAM-05). Cookie token stored as sha256; idle and absolute expiry.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | aggregate-root |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `authentication`: Credentials, MFA secrets and sessions: kept while the account exists; sessions and challenges purged after expiry plus a security review window. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /auth/sessions |
| Write path | AuthService; auth_revoke_member_sessions() on suspension (RBAC-17). |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0005_auth (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- unique token_hash
- FK (tenant_id, user_id) -> membership: only members can hold a session
- revoked_at and revoked_reason set together
- absolute_expires_at > created_at
